Troy Codebase Map
=================

Monorepo containing WordPress plugin suite for private plugin distribution.
Troy Server hosts plugins; Troy Client fetches updates from Troy Servers.

Each src/* folder is a standalone WordPress plugin.
Files named index.php are direct-access guards (empty PHP files).
Files ending in .min.js or .min.css are minified mirrors of their source counterparts.


Root
----
.gitattributes                  LF line endings, binary markers, export-ignore rules for dev files
.gitignore                      Ignores archives, logs, OS files, composer.lock, /vendor/, /.github/agents/, /.local/*
composer.json                   Monorepo Composer config: dev deps (PHPCS), scripts, replace entries for sub-packages
cspell.json                     Spell checker dictionary (custom words for WordPress/Troy terminology)
license.txt                     MIT license
phpcs.xml                       Root PHPCS ruleset referencing TSF coding standard, shared across all plugins
readme.md                       Project overview, component descriptions, requirements, planned features

.github/
	agents/
		discuss.agent.md              Copilot agent configuration for discussions
	codemap.txt                   This file
	copilot-instructions.md       Repository coding standards and conventions
	workflows/
		release.yml                   GitHub Actions: builds release ZIPs on tag push, creates draft GitHub release

.local/                           Git-tracked folder with ignored contents; local workspace storage

assets/
	logo-github-outline-192.png   Repository logo for GitHub readme


Troy Server (src/troy-server/)
------------------------------
Hosts plugin repository. Manages plugins via WP admin, Block Editor, and REST API.
Serves update checks, plugin info, downloads, and stats to Troy Clients.
Requires PHP 8.4+, MySQL 8.0.19+, WordPress 6.8+.

troy-server.php                 Main plugin file: header, constants (VERSION, DB_VERSION), loads bootstrap
.gitattributes                  Export-ignore rules for phpcs.xml
composer.json                   Composer config: wordpress-plugin type, PHP ^8.4, MIT
phpcs.xml                       Plugin-specific PHPCS overrides

bootstrap/
	hook.php                      Front-facing hooks: cron, CPT registration, REST routes, endpoint routing, stats, integrations, packages
	hook-admin.php                Admin-only hooks: scripts, menu reorder, plugin row meta, settings pages, editor assets, list-view columns
	load.php                      PSR-4 class autoloader for Troy\Server\, wires activation/deactivation handlers
	on-plugin-activation.php      Sets options autoload flags on activation
	on-plugin-deactivation.php    Disables options autoload, removes all cron jobs on deactivation

includes/
	constants.php                 Plugin constants: PLUGINS_CPT, PACKAGES_CPT, REST_NS, stats batch size, epoch delay
	upgrade.php                   Database migration system with locking, version tracking, upgrade/downgrade paths, schema management

includes/classes/
	admin-menu.class.php          Reorders WP admin menu to position Troy CPTs at custom positions (3.1184x)
	admin-scripts.class.php       Registers global admin CSS/JS and CSS custom properties for Troy theming; provides admin color scheme detection
	cron.class.php                Base cron class with schedule registration/removal; child classes override CRON_JOBS
	file-utils.class.php          WordPress Filesystem initialization and file operation utilities
	markdown.class.php            Markdown-to-HTML via bundled CommonMark/GFM vendor library
	plugin-table.class.php        Adds privacy policy link to plugin row meta on WP Plugins page
	template.class.php            Secure view template loader using secret token to prevent unauthorized inclusion
	zip-extractor.class.php       Extracts plugin/theme ZIPs to temp storage with timeout and cleanup via cron

includes/classes/api/
	info.class.php                Static reference data: locales, WP versions, license types, categories
	package.class.php             Package lookup: get package ID by slug from custom tables
	plugin.class.php              Plugin lookup: get plugin ID by slug from custom tables
	sanitize.class.php            Sanitization for SemVer strings, URLs, slugs, plugin/package data
	server.class.php              Server-level API: DB version retrieval, repository URL formatting
	slug.class.php                Slug conflict detection and resolution across plugins/packages tables
	utils.class.php               Epoch calculation for UUIDs, latest version resolution with type priority

includes/classes/endpoints/
	base-endpoint.class.php       Abstract base for public API endpoints: response helpers, clean headers, CORS
	router.class.php              URL router: parses REQUEST_URI at init, dispatches to endpoints, bypasses WP query
	ping.class.php                Health check endpoint for Troy Client connectivity verification

includes/classes/endpoints/plugins/
	download.class.php            Plugin ZIP download: file streaming, version selection, download stats recording
	info.class.php                Plugin info: WordPress-compatible thickbox data (description, screenshots, etc.)
	stats.class.php               Public plugin stats: downloads, active installs, ratings
	tags.class.php                Available released versions with metadata
	updates.class.php             WordPress-compatible update check responses

includes/classes/endpoints/packages/
	download.class.php            Package installer ZIP download with file streaming and stats recording

includes/classes/integrations/plugins/
	rest.class.php                REST API for integration management (GitHub/WP.org connect/disconnect/sync)
	store.class.php               Integration data storage; enforces single active integration per plugin, tracks sync history
	cron.class.php                Periodic integration tag syncing scheduler

includes/classes/integrations/plugins/repos/
	github.class.php              GitHub API adapter: connects repos, fetches tags, supports PAT for private repos
	wporg.class.php               WordPress.org API adapter: fetches plugin tags and versions from WP.org directory

includes/classes/packages/
	data.class.php                Package data accessor (read-only) from custom tables
	drop.class.php                Deletes package data and removes storage directory (with graveyard recovery)
	files.class.php               Package file storage management (directory helpers, ZIP paths)
	meta-boxes.class.php          Registers/renders meta boxes for Packages editor (settings, plugins, themes, download, advanced)
	rest.class.php                REST API for package CRUD operations
	zip-builder.class.php         Generates installer ZIPs from troy-installer template, embedding selected plugins/themes

includes/classes/packages/cpt/
	init.class.php                Registers Packages custom post type (non-public, admin-only)
	list-view.class.php           Packages list table: disables quick edit, adds columns (slug, plugins, themes, download)
	store.class.php               Package save/update/trash/delete lifecycle, syncs CPT to custom tables, rebuilds ZIPs

includes/classes/plugins/
	data.class.php                Plugin data accessor (read-only) from custom tables with version-aware queries
	drop.class.php                Deletes plugin data and removes ZIP storage (with graveyard recovery)
	files.class.php               Plugin file storage management (ZIP paths, directory helpers, checksums)
	readme-parser.class.php       Parses WordPress-style readme.txt from plugin ZIPs, extracts metadata and content
	rest.class.php                REST API for plugin management (versions, uploads, deletions, slug validation)
	zip-uploader.class.php        Plugin ZIP uploads: download from URL or process file upload, validate, store

includes/classes/plugins/cpt/
	block-editor.class.php        Block Editor integration: registers post meta, blocks, editor scripts/styles
	init.class.php                Registers Plugins custom post type and taxonomies
	list-view.class.php           Plugins list table: disables quick edit, adds columns (slug, version, status, integration)
	preview.class.php             Plugin thickbox preview (placeholder, not yet implemented)
	store.class.php               Plugin save lifecycle: sanitizes editor data, syncs to custom tables, processes ZIPs, parses readmes

includes/classes/settings/
	logs.class.php                Logs dashboard: enqueues assets, provides integration history/log retrieval
	main.class.php                Main settings: registers admin menu, handles tab routing and form submission
	rest.class.php                REST API for settings dashboard (stats data, logs data)
	stats.class.php               Stats dashboard: enqueues assets, provides overview/top plugins/epoch/PHP/WP/locale statistics

includes/classes/stats/
	aggregator.class.php          Aggregates live stats into summary tables in batches via cron using SQL GROUP BY
	cron.class.php                Cron scheduler for stats aggregation and maintenance tasks

includes/classes/themes/
	(empty, theme support planned)

includes/views/
	settings/
		main.php                    Settings page shell: tab navigation (Plugin Stats, Package Stats, Logs, Settings)
		tab-setup.php               Setup tab: Troy repo header, options form (currently no configurable settings)
		tab-plugin-stats.php        Plugin stats tab: overview cards, top plugins, epoch comparisons, PHP/WP/locale tables
		tab-package-stats.php       Package stats tab: package download statistics with auto-refresh
		tab-logs.php                Logs tab: integration sync history and log entries with refresh controls
	editor/
		packages/
			advanced-meta-box.php   Advanced options: install timeout, deactivate/delete on completion, notice severity, network activation
			download-meta-box.php   Package download URL display (or prompt to publish first)
			plugins-meta-box.php    Checkbox list of plugins to include in package with per-plugin options
			settings-meta-box.php   Package slug, server URL, general configuration
			themes-meta-box.php     Placeholder: "Theme support is coming soon"

library/js/
	constants.js                  Shared constants: author queries, block templates for plugin editor
	icons.js                      SVG icon components for the block editor

library/js/admin/
	troy-mode.js                  Troy Mode toggle: hides non-essential WP admin menu items, persists via user meta

library/js/settings/
	main.js                       Settings page: tab switching with smooth navigation
	stats.js                      Stats dashboard: fetches/renders stats via REST, date ranges, auto-refresh, dynamic tables
	logs.js                       Logs dashboard: fetches/renders log entries via REST with auto-refresh

library/js/utils/
	assign.js                     Recursive deep-defaults object merge utility
	escape.js                     HTML/entity escaping and decoding for safe DOM rendering
	format.js                     Relative timestamps ("X minutes ago"), date formatting
	sanitize.js                   Client-side number formatting and string cleanup
	sort.js                       SemVer-aware sorting for version arrays
	timing.js                     Debounce and async control utilities

library/js/editor/components/
	create-popover-props.js       Generates consistent popover positioning props
	image-upload-control.js       Media library image picker with popover preview (logo/banner uploads)
	metadata-item.js              Label/value metadata display pairs in editor panels
	panel-row.js                  Layout wrapper for editor panel content rows
	styled-help.js                Styled help text renderer for editor panels

library/js/editor/plugins/
	content.js                    Resets/refills block template from custom table data, syncs content on save
	main.js                       Registers Gutenberg sidebar panels (slug, status, author, versions, integrations, URLs)
	notices.js                    Contextual editor notices (warnings, errors) based on plugin store state
	store.js                      Plugin editor data store: REST data fetching, caching, state management

library/js/editor/plugins/blocks/
	author.js                     Block: plugin author display with dynamic name from WP users
	banner.js                     Block: plugin banner image
	download.js                   Block: download button
	headergroup.js                Block: header group wrapper
	heading.js                    Block: section heading with inner blocks
	logo.js                       Block: plugin logo/icon with media upload
	tab-content.js                Block: individual tab panel within tabs container
	tabs.js                       Block: tabbed content container for description sections
	title-author-wrap.js          Block: title and author wrapper container
	title.js                      Block: editable plugin title, auto-syncs to post title

library/js/editor/plugins/components/
	auto-process-tags-control.js  Sidebar: toggle for automatic tag processing on integration sync
	integration-control.js        Sidebar: GitHub/WP.org integration management (connect, sync, disconnect, history)
	menu-dropdown.js              Reusable dropdown menu helper
	plugin-author-control.js      Sidebar: plugin author selector with WP user search
	plugin-slug-control.js        Sidebar: slug editor with conflict detection
	plugin-status-control.js      Sidebar: release status toggle (published/hidden/beta)
	plugin-versions-control.js    Sidebar: version management (upload, delete, set latest, type selection)
	readme-settings-control.js    Sidebar: readme.txt parsing/generation settings
	short-description-control.js  Sidebar: short description field with character limit
	urls-control.js               Sidebar: plugin URLs (homepage, donate, support, etc.)

library/js/editor/packages/
	meta-boxes.js                 Packages editor: checkbox interactions, slug validation, REST calls for meta boxes

library/css/admin/
	troy-mode.css                 Troy Mode: hides non-essential admin items, toggle button styling

library/css/editor/components/
	components.css                Shared editor components: PanelRow, MetadataItem, loading states

library/css/editor/plugins/
	blocks.css                    Plugin editor blocks: hides default post title, figcaptions, block layout
	components.css                Plugin editor sidebar: image previews, version lists, integration panels

library/css/editor/packages/
	meta-boxes.css                Package editor meta boxes: plugin list grid, checkbox items, slug fields

library/css/list-view/
	packages.css                  Packages list table: column widths, mobile visibility

library/css/settings/
	logs.css                      Logs dashboard: controls, log entries, history timeline, status badges
	main.css                      Settings page: layout, tabs, footer, nag suppression, responsive design
	stats.css                     Stats dashboard: date range controls, stat cards, tables, charts

library/packages/
	troy-installer.php            Troy Installer template: self-contained plugin that installs Troy Client and vendor plugins
	readme.txt                    Readme for the auto-generated installer package
	phpcs.xml                     PHPCS overrides for the installer template

vendor/markdown/
	Bundled CommonMark/GFM library for Markdown rendering. Third-party packages:
	dflydev-dflydev-dot-access-data/    Dot-notation data access
	nette-schema/                       Schema validation
	nette-utils/                        Nette utility classes
	php-fig-event-dispatcher/           PSR-14 event dispatcher interface
	thephpleague-commonmark/            CommonMark Markdown parser (core library)
	thephpleague-config/                Configuration management


Troy Client (src/troy-client/)
------------------------------
Connects to Troy Servers to fetch plugin updates, info, and dependencies.
Replaces WP.org update checks for Troy-managed plugins.
Requires PHP 7.4+, WordPress 6.7+. Network-activated on multisite.

troy-client.php                 Main plugin file: header, constants (VERSION, DB_VERSION), loads bootstrap
.gitattributes                  Export-ignore rules
composer.json                   Composer config: wordpress-plugin type, PHP ~7.4 || ^8.0, MIT
phpcs.xml                       Plugin-specific PHPCS overrides

bootstrap/
	hook.php                      Registers all hooks: plugin protection, update API, headers, site health, dependencies
	load.php                      PSR-4 class autoloader for Troy\Client\, wires activation/deactivation
	on-plugin-activation.php      Sets flag to recheck Troy dependencies on activation
	on-plugin-deactivation.php    Deletes all Troy Client caches/options on deactivation

includes/
	api.php                       Public API functions (e.g., plugin_file_to_slug), ~495 lines of utility helpers

includes/classes/
	dependencies.class.php        Discovers and auto-installs Troy-declared plugin dependencies
	headers.class.php             Registers/reads custom plugin headers (Troy Server, Troy Dependencies)
	http.class.php                Filters HTTP request args and user-agent for Troy Server communication
	plugin-table.class.php        Adds custom row-meta links on WP Plugins page for Troy-managed plugins
	plugins-api.class.php         Intercepts plugins_api and update_plugins transient to serve updates from Troy Server
	protect-client.class.php      Hides Troy Client from plugin lists, blocks deactivation/deletion when daemon present
	sanitize.class.php            Sanitization/validation methods for Troy Client data
	site-health.class.php         Site Health status tests and debug info for Troy Server connectivity

includes/classes/skins/
	background.class.php          Silent WP_Upgrader_Skin: suppresses output, logs errors only (background installs)


Troy Client Daemon (src/troy-client-daemon/)
--------------------------------------------
Must-use plugin that enforces Troy Client presence.
Forces install/activation of Troy Client, blocks WP update API if Client is inactive.

troy-client-daemon.php          MU-plugin: forces Troy Client install/activation, blocks update API without Client
.gitattributes                  Export-ignore rules
composer.json                   Composer config: wordpress-muplugin type, PHP ~7.4 || ^8.0, MIT
phpcs.xml                       Plugin-specific PHPCS overrides


Troy Installer (src/troy-installer/)
------------------------------------
Standalone installer plugin that installs Troy Client and vendor plugins.
Distributed to end-users; self-deactivates after installation completes.

troy-installer.php              Full installer plugin with custom upgrader skin, ~700 lines
phpcs.xml                       Plugin-specific PHPCS overrides


Troy Client Snippets
--------------------

src/troy-client-channel/
	snippet.php                   wp-config snippet: defines Troy\Client\CHANNEL = 'beta' for beta release updates

src/troy-client-hide/
	snippet.php                   wp-config snippet: defines Troy\Client\HIDE = true, hides Troy Client from plugins list

src/troy-embed/
	snippet.php                   Standalone snippet: auto-installs Troy Client via Plugin_Upgrader on admin_init
